_readme: Customer testimonials shown on the home and about pages. 'initials' drives the avatar circle. Replace with your own once you have real reviews — please do not publish reviews you did not receive.

testimonials.quote: I wore the Lumen hoops every single day for eight months, including two weeks by the sea, and they look exactly the way they did when they arrived. I have never managed that with any other pair.
testimonials.name: Ananya R.

testimonials.quote: My skin reacts to almost everything, so I had low expectations. Six months in the Eterna ring has not left a single mark on my finger and there is no green line underneath it.
testimonials.name: Priya M.

testimonials.quote: The layered necklace was the thing that sold me on the brand. Two chains that genuinely do not tangle — I did not think that existed at this price.
testimonials.name: Sneha K.

testimonials.quote: Bought the signature set as a wedding gift and ended up ordering a second one for myself. The gold tone matches perfectly across all three pieces, which you really notice in photos.
testimonials.name: Divya S.

testimonials.quote: Monsoon in Kerala destroys jewelry. This is the first silver anklet I have owned that made it through a full season without going dull, and it was the cheapest thing in the order.
testimonials.name: Meera J.

testimonials.quote: The herringbone is the real test and it passed. I have kinked two of these before. This one has been worn constantly for four months and still lies completely flat.
testimonials.name: Riya T.
